# intenter doctor

Check the installation and suggest fixes

Runs every installation check — the binary on PATH, configuration, database,
daemon and service, endpoint permissions, Claude Code and its hooks, leftovers
of a pre-rename install, settings backups, and whether an update is available
or the terminal update check can appear — and prints a fix for each failure.
Exits non-zero when any check fails, so it can gate a script.

## Usage

```text
intenter doctor
```

## Examples

```console
intenter doctor
intenter doctor --json
```
